items.title: Mukesh...For Whom The Bells Chime
items.description: The richest moment of a billionaire’s life, it turns out, cost nothing at all. He simply listened. And the sound of thebell that later chimed, setting off one of the biggest scrambles for an opportunity to create wealth, suddenly seemed to mean very little.

items.title: ED registers money laundering case against Subhash Chandra: Report
items.description: Chandra is alleged to have inflated his net worth to avail loans from LICHFL and then defaulted on them

items.title: Knowledge Marine bags Rs 300 crore dredging order from New Mangalore Port
items.description: The company has "secured its largest-ever dredging order worth Rs 303.17 crore at New Mangalore Port Authority", it said in an exchange filing.

items.title: At 1 million each, legacy two-wheeler brands accelerate EV capacity build-up as startups lose ground
items.description: TVS Motor, Bajaj Auto and Hero MotoCorp are ramping up production to meet rising demand, while early electric two-wheeler entrants struggle with shrinking market shares and low capacity utilisation
